testcase.name: F2: ratio mode is clamped to the panel value: a speed seen only by the partial integral's nodes cannot make lengthAt exceed the length at the panel end (F_k in [0, I2_k], contract 5.5)

F3: iteration cap: a target inside a jump of F (unreachable tolerance) near t = 2^-40, where the bracket cannot collapse within 64 iterations, and zero speed at the first iterate: all 64 iterations run (332 to 336 evaluations); the result is the bracket end with the smaller residual, on the correct side of the jump and within 2^-47 (b - a) + 2 ulp of it

Non-finite derivative after build (contract 9, R2 mutation survivor M12): a curve finite at every table node but NaN elsewhere makes lengthAt and parameterAt throw ArithmeticException, never return NaN

F2: pathological panels (I2/I1 overflowing, I1 = 0, I2 = 1000 I1, I1 = 1000 I2, I2/I1 underflowing) on finite tables: lengthAt and parameterAt are finite, monotone and follow the linear fallback of contract 5.5 exactly

Stationary intervals (R2 mutation survivors M26, M15): parameterAt(length()) == t1 even when the last panels have zero length; a distance reached at the start of a stationary interval maps to its start (the smallest panel k with S_(k+1) >= distance)

F3: a speed discontinuous at a 2^-41 scale (F has jumps, the tolerance is unreachable; in this scenario every exit is by tolerance or by bracket collapse): every result is within the tolerance or is the better end of an adjacent-double bracket; at most 336 evaluations; deterministic

F3: Newton creep (a speed spike at the root, invisible to the quadrature, makes Newton steps tiny): at most 336 derivative evaluations; |lengthAt(t) - s| <= max(tau 2^-10, 4 (b - a) 2^-47); t within the bound of the exact inverse -1 + sqrt(1 + 2s)

F1: nonzero subnormal-speed lines and constant-speed spirals converge with 16 panels; tau = max(abs, rel L0, 1024 MIN_VALUE); |L - L*| <= rounding allowance with the absolute underflow term 8 K MIN_VALUE

F3: ties go to the upper end: (a) a target exactly halfway across a panel shorter than 2 tau 2^-10 returns b_k; (b) after a collapse exit between adjacent doubles with exactly equal residuals, the upper double is returned
F3: a target equal to the length at a panel end (an end of the bracket is already within the tolerance) returns that end exactly, with no derivative evaluation
